confidence_notes: Meal, coffee and beer anchors come from web-search results: Numbeo's Jaipur page (Oct 2026: cheap meal about INR 300-400, mid-range for two about INR 1,000-1,200, cappuccino about INR 145-160, domestic draft beer about INR 250) and CityCost (mid-range for two about INR 1,196). I nudged these up slightly for tourist venues and converted at about INR 95/USD, the rate implied by CityCost's INR/USD pairs. I did not verify the INR rate independently. Cocktail and wine had weak direct data: an Expatistan club cocktail of about INR 717 (2023, 8 price points) and upscale hotel-bar wine glasses at INR 749-1,499. I therefore set them at roughly 2.3x and 2.1x the beer price, a typical Indian bar/restaurant relationship. Accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates for a July low-season month. I consulted no accommodation searches or live listings, so they are the least certain. The search tool returned summaries rather than pages I opened. The RBA search summary noted that some cached RBA pages showed older dates, and I used the 18 Nov 2026 figure it reported.
comparable_city_reasoning: No single proxy city. Food and drink use Jaipur-specific Numbeo/CityCost/Expatistan figures. Accommodation is placed by general knowledge in the range of other Rajasthan and North India tourist cities such as Udaipur, Jodhpur and Agra, adjusted for Jaipur's July low season.
